name: @akaya/grocery-agent
description: Akaya Grocery Agent: parses grocery lists (EN/HI/Hinglish), compares Instamart, Blinkit, Zepto, BigBasket and Amazon Fresh, builds the cheapest/fastest/split basket, fills the cart and notifies you to pay. Never auto-pays. Runs on Mock sample data out of the box.

scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.lint: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix backend run typecheck
